claims.explanation: The denominator simplifies to \(\sqrt[3]{2}+2\sqrt[3]{2}=3\sqrt[3]{2}\), not \(4\sqrt[3]{2}\). The coefficients 1 and 2 add to 3.
The product of the cube roots is \(\sqrt[3]{2\cdot 4}=\sqrt[3]{8}=2\), not \(2+4=6\).
This simplification is invalid: \(\frac{\sqrt[3]{4}}{24}\) cannot be reduced to \(\frac{\sqrt[3]{4}}{6}\). Those two quantities are not equal.
